{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "NodeNext",
    "moduleResolution": "NodeNext",
    "lib": ["ES2022"],
    "strict": true,
    "exactOptionalPropertyTypes": true,
    "noUncheckedIndexedAccess": true,
    "noImplicitOverride": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "declaration": false,
    "sourceMap": true,
    "outDir": "./dist",
    "rootDir": "./src"
  },
  "include": ["src"],
  "exclude": ["dist", "node_modules", "src/**/*.test.ts"]
}
